join_key: pms_category (tender demand -> our part numbers -> observed rival prices)
unit: one row per opportunity x category; addressable_eur is per year at our avg selling price
rival_definition: aftermarket-brand prices only: aftermarket_retail, aftermarket_rrp, aftermarket_trade, marketplace, online_median, quote, survey_list, survey_workshop
genuine_definition: genuine Isuzu sold outside our network, separate columns: dealer, genuine_grey
honest_note: The tender engine values a fleet's parts demand at OUR price. This file adds the competitive side, but only where an observed rival price exists. Most categories currently show 0% coverage because the parts scraper has only covered a small number of part numbers — do not read a blank as 'no competitor'.
